To my fellow trainers,

We do our best to make collecting fun and worry-free! All sales are final. Please review photos and item descriptions carefully before purchasing. In the rare case something arrives damaged or isn't as described, please reach out within 3 days of delivery.


Orders ship within 2 business days:

  • Single cards under $20 ship in quality sleeves and card savers via eBay Standard Envelope (with tracking).
  • Multiple cards, binders, and graded cards are bubble wrapped and shipped either in bubble mailers or sturdy mailer boxes via USPS Ground Advantage. For higher-value orders, we may upgrade to USPS Priority Mail at no extra cost.
  • Plushies, toys, and books are padded, boxed, and shipped via USPS Ground Advantage.

We combine shipping automatically (at least we try to), and you'll save more with our multi-item discounts! Load up your cart, grow your collection, and thank you for teaming up with Playable Bulk!
